purpose: Resolve direct SBI Holdings USA ownership evidence in Evernorth and correct the distinction between one verified Kamilah Stevenson public YouTube upload and an unverified personal channel.

sources.relationship: Reporting person checked 10% Owner; this filing is solely on behalf of SBI Holdings USA, Inc.
sources.class_c_terms: One Class C share is convertible to one Class A share at holder option, subject to articles and the 39.9% SBI Group ownership limit; no additional consideration is payable on conversion.
sources.excerpt: This Form 3 is filed solely by SBI Holdings USA, Inc.; the Reporting Person directly holds 1,633,180 shares of Class C Common Stock.
sources.interpretation: Direct primary evidence that SBI Holdings USA, Inc. held Evernorth equity as of October 9. This is Evernorth stock ownership, not a report of XRP held by SBI Holdings USA.

definitions.control_statement: Each of the four SBI Stockholders is identified as an entity controlled by SBI.

sources.excerpt: each of which are entities controlled by SBI.
sources.interpretation: The issuer filing links the four named investing entities to SBI Holdings, Inc. by control. The Form 3 separately proves SBI Holdings USA's direct Evernorth shareholding.

sources.subject: Evernorth Holdings Inc.
sources.interpretation: This October 28 Schedule 13G is filed by Alta Partners, not SBI Holdings USA. Do not conflate it with SBI's October 20 Form 3.

first_party_site.finding: First-party branded site identifies Dr. Kamilah Stevenson and discusses wealth education, investing and crypto.

verified_public_youtube_videos.title: Thinking Your Way Into Health | Kamilah Stevenson | TEDxWillowCreek
verified_public_youtube_videos.description_crosslink: Video description says to learn more at kamilahstevenson.com, linking the speaker to her first-party domain.
verified_public_youtube_videos.topic: health and mindset; not an XRP or crypto-market video

personal_channel_candidate.reason: No first-party site or verified social account was found linking to this channel. Similar branding and descriptions are insufficient to attribute it.

other_video_candidates_not_attributed.title: Why Most People Will Lose Their Crypto Wealth (Even If They're Right)
other_video_candidates_not_attributed.reason: Third-party summary labels Kamilah Stevenson and transcript says Camila Stevenson, but no channel ID or first-party link was established.

directory_risk.interpretation: Multiple similar-name profiles increase impersonation and misattribution risk; directory counts are not authoritative identity evidence.

entity_separation.SBI_Holdings_Inc: Japanese parent company identified in Evernorth S-1 as controlling the four SBI Stockholders.
entity_separation.SBI_Holdings_USA_Inc: U.S. subsidiary directly reporting Evernorth equity ownership on Form 3.
entity_separation.SBIC_East_Central_West: Separate Japanese regional statutory investment companies; not SBI Holdings and not the reporting person in this Form 3.

do_not_infer: Evernorth share ownership is not proof of XRP ownership by SBI Holdings USA.
Class C conversion is subject to the 39.9% ownership cap and must not be counted as unrestricted Class A voting shares.
The Alta Partners Schedule 13G is not an SBI filing.
The TEDx video verifies one public speaker attribution but does not verify the @drkamilahstevenson personal channel.
The Glasp candidate video is not attributed until channel ownership is verified.

evernorth_eloc_effectiveness_update.facility: CF Principal Investments LLC / Cantor committed equity line
evernorth_eloc_effectiveness_update.interpretation: The S-1 registration statement associated with the ELOC became effective October 30, satisfying the registration-effectiveness condition. This establishes potential availability of the facility after other contractual conditions, not that Evernorth issued a purchase notice, sold shares to Cantor or received cash.
evernorth_eloc_effectiveness_update.fee_status: The $521,893.50 commitment fee is described as non-refundable and due after effectiveness; payment evidence was not found in the reviewed material.
evernorth_eloc_effectiveness_update.drawdown_status: No post-effectiveness drawdown or settlement was established in the issuer filings reviewed through November 7, 2026. Absence of a filing is not proof that no draw occurred.
